summary: This bill requires the Attorney General to submit a report identifying effective strategies and best practices to reduce mental health stigma among law enforcement officers, encourage their use of mental health resources, and ensure the confidentiality of these services.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on the mental health and well-being of law enforcement officers, which is a component of criminal justice. By seeking to reduce stigma and encourage mental health access for officers, it aims to improve the effectiveness and support systems within the criminal justice system.
